meta.scope: Iran Batch 7 — Social protection densification, petrochemicals / non-oil exports, and digital / e-commerce framing.

candidates.title: Social protection and cash-transfer statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and World Bank-aligned sources
candidates.description: Statistics and indicators on social assistance, cash transfers and related social-protection programmes. Cash transfers and subsidy-related support interact tightly with high inflation and the targeted-subsidy system.
candidates.notes: Social-protection densification linked to the subsidy and poverty clusters.

candidates.title: Petrochemical production and export statistics
candidates.description: Production capacity, output and export statistics for the petrochemical sector. Petrochemicals are a major non-oil foreign-exchange earner and a significant share of non-oil exports and industrial value added.
candidates.notes: Key non-oil industrial and export node that partially offsets pure crude dependence.

candidates.title: Non-oil export statistics
candidates.description: Aggregate and commodity-structure statistics on non-oil exports. Petrochemicals, minerals, agricultural products and other manufactures form the main residual external-earnings base under oil sanctions.
candidates.notes: External diversification densification of the trade cluster.

candidates.title: Digital economy and e-commerce framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from licensing and platform sources
candidates.description: Framing and available statistics on digital businesses, e-commerce licensing and online activity. Digital activity continues under constraints on international platforms, payment systems and connectivity.
candidates.notes: Digital densification under sanctions-constrained technology and payment conditions.

candidates.title: Iran social–petrochemical–digital densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from social, petrochemical and digital sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding social protection and cash-transfer statistics, petrochemical production and exports, non-oil export statistics, and digital/e-commerce framing into a coherent welfare–non-oil–digital layer.
